campaign.prototype.title: The Unwritten Line
campaign.prototype.summary: Two short chapters about listening, questioning and leaving room for doubt. Technical prototype; not an approved main story.
chapter.cp01.title: Two Voices
chapter.cp01.summary: A sealed page. Two conflicting accounts. Which will you hear first? An example scene with a playable practice duel.
chapter.cp02.title: An Empty Line
chapter.cp02.summary: Your first choice is remembered. An unanswered question can remain unanswered. An example scene that settles no mystery.
dialogue.threshold.01: A technical example stage: a sealed page lies between two empty chairs. Two voices carry from a distance.
dialogue.threshold.02: They both say the page belongs to them. I promised I would not open it.
dialogue.threshold.03: If I hear one voice first, the other must wait. If I look for myself, I break my word.
scene.threshold.title: At the Threshold
dialogue.first_question.01: You do not have to decide who is right. Only what we do next.
dialogue.first_question.02: This choice changes the next dialogue and the recap. It decides no world history.
scene.first_question.title: What Comes First
dialogue.preserve.01: Then the seal stays closed. I will bring them both to the same table.
dialogue.preserve.02: Perhaps listening is not enough. But today I will make time for it.
dialogue.preserve.03: Sena remembers that you took her promise seriously.
scene.preserve.title: A Promise Kept
dialogue.compare.01: Do not open it. Compare their accounts first: what did they actually see?
dialogue.compare.02: That helps. I was starting to mistake their certainty for proof.
dialogue.compare.03: Sena remembers that you asked for evidence.
scene.compare.title: A Closer Look
dialogue.practice.01: The example story pauses for a practice duel. Its outcome says nothing about which account is true.
dialogue.practice.02: A duel has five combat paths. Creatures occupy them; impulses and relics add to your options.
dialogue.practice.03: Convergence is an alternative game objective through path control. Its meaning within the world remains open.
scene.practice.title: Five Paths in a Duel
dialogue.victory.01: You won the practice duel. The page remains unread.
dialogue.victory.02: That is enough for today. We can move on without claiming something we do not know.
scene.victory.title: One Step Further
dialogue.defeat.01: The practice duel is lost. Your choice is saved; you can try the encounter again.
dialogue.defeat.02: We have time for another try. The page is not going anywhere.
scene.defeat.title: A Moment to Breathe
dialogue.return.01: You wanted to keep the promise. I heard both voices. Their accounts still do not agree.
dialogue.return.02: You wanted to examine the accounts. I asked questions. Now I can see the gap between their words more clearly.
dialogue.return.03: No hidden answer has been uncovered. Your chosen approach determines the recap.
scene.return.title: What You Chose
dialogue.margin.01: The four powers are the Twelve Houses, Stillwatch, Manyshape and the Ninth Hour. Neutral is a card affiliation, not a fifth power.
dialogue.margin.02: Their card identities concern memory and return, protection and stability, change and movement, and causality and sequence.
dialogue.margin.03: These game identities establish neither secret leaders nor the cause of the time correction.
scene.margin.title: Four Perspectives
dialogue.blank.01: A name appears in the margin of this technical sample: Eira. This sample adds no biography and does not resolve her mystery.
dialogue.blank.02: Not every empty space is waiting for us to fill it. Sometimes it marks the limit of what we know.
dialogue.blank.03: The character view unlocks only a list of open questions. It contains no hidden answer.
scene.blank.title: One Line Stays Empty
dialogue.last_question.01: What should I write beneath the two accounts?
scene.last_question.title: How We Continue
dialogue.ending_record.01: “Contradiction unresolved.” It is not much. But no one will mistake our uncertainty for an answer.
dialogue.ending_record.02: Ending: the open question is explicitly recorded. The example campaign is complete, and each chapter can be replayed.
scene.ending_record.title: Marking the Boundary
dialogue.ending_open.01: Then I will leave the line empty. With a mark beside it: something is still missing here.
dialogue.ending_open.02: Ending: the open question remains visible. The example campaign is complete, and each chapter can be replayed.
scene.ending_open.title: Room for an Answer
choice.approach.preserve: Keep the promise. Hear both voices.
choice.approach.compare: Keep the page sealed. Examine the accounts.

knowledge.sena.belief: Character belief: Sena hopes both accounts can be heard. This is her stance in the sample, not established world knowledge.
knowledge.sena.player_note: Player knowledge: you completed the example encounter. Sena remembers your approach; the truth of either account remains unresolved.
